title: Builder BLD-103: Spine and outline

source.ref: Owner approval 2026-11-02: build the next-gen builder from the role and block contracts. BLD-103.

detail: B1 Shell, pass BLD-103 (spec: docs/EDITOR-NEXT.md#bld-103). Spine and outline. Scope: components/builder/spine. Build: Spine reads the node tree: one thumbnail per section, selected state, drag to reorder, + between. Outline drawer: section names from role intent and the title slot, hidden-on-device dimming. Done when: Reorder by drag and by keyboard produces the same document; Doc-safety corpus round-trips after reorder. Gates: vitest suite (required test job), check:node-document-safety, a11y ratchet, Pass probes, check:backlog, check:one-list, check:adr, check:id-collisions. After: BLD-102. Loop: build, validate, repair (3 cycles, classes in EDITOR-NEXT.md), record.
